gates.name: native_protocol_shape
required_cases: plugin builds through the supported DFHack protobuf macro
method manifest remains exactly Handshake and ReadObservation
string and symbol inventories contain no mutation route
protocol manifest is exactly 1.1 and bridge implementation is exactly 0.2.0

gates.name: cursor_and_retained_window
required_cases: cursor before retained window with explicit gap
cursor immediately before oldest retained report without gap

gates.name: canonicality_and_bounds
required_cases: field tampering changes or invalidates the canonical digest

gates.name: observation_atomicity_and_restart
required_cases: one-page moving-world observation binds citizens and announcements to one RPC
paused multipage citizen read reproduces identical announcement fields
announcement drift between citizen pages rejects the entire assembly
bridge restart changes generation and fences the old cursor
aborted partial assembly publishes no anchor

gates.name: cold_agent_orientation
required_cases: complete suffix is distinguished from complete history
retained-window gap is surfaced as uncertainty
partial suffix emits one bounded continuation
announcement attention items cite canonical batch evidence
no announcement creates mutation authority or an autonomous action recommendation

promotion_rule: No protocol-1.1 tuple may be promoted until every A1-A6 case is represented in a clean, source-bound, immutable live receipt and the existing R1-R5 fortress/citizen campaign also passes for the same source and native plugin bytes.
claims_not_established: complete announcement history before the oldest retained report
compatibility with any untested DF or DFHack build
durable report retention across game restart
protection against a compromised local host
